description: KubeSphere 4.0.0 through 4.1.3 contains a command injection vulnerability in the terminal v1alpha2 file download endpoint where the path query parameter is inserted via fmt.Sprintf into sh -c tar commands executed inside the target container, and the DownloadFile handler fails to perform its own pods/exec authorization check. Attackers with only pod get permission, including built-in read-only project-viewer, workspace-viewer and cluster-viewer roles, can supply shell metacharacters in the path parameter to execute arbitrary commands inside any viewable container without holding pod exec permission.
